about: Number Quest placement item bank (Tally's Sorting Game, spec §4.3): ~250 item templates across four strands and half-grade rungs K.0–8.0. A template is a question shape with randomised numbers inside stated constraints (gen), a CCSS domain/cluster tag, the misconception its main distractor diagnoses, a response type and a reading load. Concrete items are generated by generator.js; scripts/number-quest-placement-check.js proves every template generates solvable items with correct, unique keys. Rungs are curriculum-order judgements by the writers (spec §4.3), not psychometric calibrations. PRO LOCK (2026-11-14): rungs 6.0-8.0 were rebuilt. Every template there is locked to a real grade 6-8 cluster (ccssClusterCode); the 63 templates that only repeated earlier content with bigger numbers (15 of them under grade and domain pairs CCSS-M does not have) were retired to retired.json and are never dealt again; 77 new templates use the archetypes in generator-pro.js. Nothing below rung 6 changed: tests/unit/number-quest-placement-pro.test.js pins those templates and the items they deal by hash.
